title: DRC, M23-Led Alliance Agree Roadmap for Peace Talks After Five-Day Swiss Talks
detail: August 23, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo's government and the AFC/M23-led rebel alliance agreed on a roadmap 'setting out sequenced steps and timelines for negotiations' under the framework agreement the two sides signed in Doha in November 2025. The roadmap follows five days of talks in Switzerland (Aug 17-21) that also included representatives from the United States, Qatar, Togo, Switzerland and the African Union Commission. The parties agreed a standardized method for reporting ceasefire violations and a mechanism to address problems implementing the Doha agreement — a step forward after the process had stalled for months, with Rwandan-backed M23 forces still holding Goma and Bukavu and roughly 7 million people displaced in eastern DRC. The Doha track runs in parallel with the U.S.-brokered Washington Accords (signed Dec 4, 2025), whose own implementation timeline has repeatedly slipped.

title: Israeli Strikes Kill Three in Gaza as Netanyahu, Katz Threaten to 'Intensify Strikes' Over Kite Launches
detail: August 23, 2026 — Two separate Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip killed at least three Palestinians, including a four-year-old boy, and wounded several others, according to Palestinian health officials — the latest in a string of near-daily strikes since the nominal October 2025 ceasefire took hold. The same evening, Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz held an assessment with IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir and warned they would 'intensify strikes' and order new evacuations of parts of the Strip in response to kites, balloons and drones launched toward Israeli border communities — at least four kites landed near Kibbutz Nahal Oz over the weekend, though the army said nothing dangerous was found on them. Hamas dismissed the objects as 'children's toys' and accused Israel of using a fabricated pretext to justify continued strikes and undermine the ceasefire framework.
